{{Top}}
[[File:Imperial_Emblem.svg|thumb|right|200px|The Imperial crest]]
The '''Imperial crest''' was the official symbol of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and used on many things including uniforms and consoles after the Empire's founding in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It was a variant of the [[Order of Dai Bendu|Order of Dai Bendu's]] [[Bendu symbol|symbol]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its waning days as their own [[Republic crest/Legends|crest]]. The crest enjoyed a lifespan of over a century and a half; as by [[130 ABY]], the crest still was in use by the [[Fel Empire]].

The crest was used on the symbol of a number of Imperial organizations as well as on the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[House Benelex]] insignia.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial crest was designed by [[John Mollo]], the [[Wikipedia:Costume designer|costume designer]] for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In the [[Ask Lobot|''Q&A'']] feature of the [[Star Wars Insider 98|98th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, Mollo revealed that he based the Imperial insignia on shapes used in 18th century fortifications.
